goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, compose a private memo, and navigate to the June 2026 calendar view.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Personal reminder for the weekend.' into the text input field labeled 'Any thoughts...'.
Click the 'Private' button to set the memo's visibility, then click the 'Save' button to publish the entry.
Click the 'June 2026' button in the calendar widget to switch the view to the full year calendar.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to the main dashboard after signing up.
The memo 'Personal reminder for the weekend.' appears in the feed with a timestamp of 'now' and is marked as private.
The interface transitions to a full-year calendar view for 2026, displaying all months.
The 'June' month within the 2026 calendar view is highlighted or selected.
No error messages are displayed during account creation, memo saving, or navigation.
